records.text: Israel had been working with Al-Qaeda or an Al-Qaeda-adjacent group in Syria.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Obviously, Israel had been working with Al Qaeda. ... or an al-Qaeda-adjacent group. I think Al-Nusra is the name of the group

verification.notes: Multiple investigations document that Israel armed and funded Syrian rebel groups near the Golan, so the broad claim of working with Syrian opposition forces has substantial support. Available reliable evidence does not establish that the supported groups were Al-Qaeda itself; allegations of direct Nusra support in UN records are presented by Syrian representatives rather than as independent UN findings. The broader rebel-support claim is true, while the specific Al-Qaeda identity is not conclusively established.

sources.title: Inside Israel’s Secret Program to Back Syrian Rebels
sources.relevance: Detailed investigation based on interviews with more than two dozen rebel participants documents Israeli funding and arms for southern Syrian groups, but does not establish they were Al-Qaeda.

sources.title: Israel and Iran Are Waging a Secret War in Syria
sources.relevance: Independent synthesis corroborates Israeli funding of rebel groups to block Iran-backed forces.

sources.title: UN General Assembly Fourth Committee summary record A/C.4/71/SR.14
sources.relevance: Records Syria’s allegation of Israeli support to the Nusrah Front; used as evidence that the allegation was formally made, not as an independent UN finding.

records.text: Under Barack Obama, the United States armed Al-Qaeda offshoots while helping Israel turn Syria into a failed state.
records.speaker: Ana Kasparian

appearances.snippet: And a lot of people don't know this. We wanted to assist Israel in turning. Syria into a failed state and we certainly succeeded in that mission so under Obama we started arming literal terrorists including like Al-Qaeda offshoots

verification.notes: The Obama administration ran covert and overt programs arming vetted Syrian rebels, and official reporting confirms some U.S.-supplied equipment was surrendered to or captured by al-Nusra, an al-Qaeda affiliate. Evidence does not show a stated U.S. policy to arm al-Qaeda directly, nor does it establish that the program purpose was to help Israel turn Syria into a failed state.

sources.title: Trump ends CIA arms support for anti-Assad Syria rebels
sources.relevance: Reuters report confirms the Obama-era CIA program to equip and train Syrian rebels.

sources.title: U.S. draws line on protecting CIA-backed rebels in Syria
sources.relevance: Reports that a U.S.-trained commander gave American weapons to al-Nusra.

sources.title: Congressional Research Service: Armed Conflict in Syria
sources.relevance: Documents U.S.-origin weapons captured by al-Nusra and other extremist groups.
